integrity: The stated class profile and numerical formula are proved for all nonnegative integer scales. A standalone verifier independently checks finite scales 0 through 7; these computations are not used to infer the infinite claim.
limitations: The proof classifies only factor lengths that are integral powers of three. No general arbitrary-length cyclic-complexity formula, full rotational occurrence profile, or independent audit is claimed. Possible inaccessible or unindexed equivalent work remains a risk.
title: Triadic cyclic complexity of the Cantor word
